listing.name: Tyrian 2000 / OpenTyrian2000 (andyvand)
listing.summary: Play OpenTyrian2000 using the upstream Windows package and its included data folder.

steps.title: Keep the portable package together
steps.instruction: Extract the Windows MinGW x64 ZIP into a separate folder. This selected package includes the upstream data directory; keep it beside opentyrian2000.exe.

steps.title: Use the included player
steps.instruction: Finish setup with opentyrian2000.exe and its folder, then choose Play. For other packages that require additional data, follow the upstream Tyrian 2000 data instructions.

steps.title: Install the upstream Linux package
steps.instruction: On Debian-compatible Linux choose the official amd64 or arm64 DEB for your machine. Install it using your package manager and start opentyrian2000. Use the same package manager to replace it.

steps.title: Open the upstream Mac app
steps.instruction: If downloading in Portcove, clear Extract the archive after downloading. Unpack opentyrian2000-macOS.zip with Mac Archive Utility to retain its framework links. Open opentyrian2000.app from its permanent folder on Intel or Apple Silicon.

steps.title: Keep the Tyrian 2000 data
steps.instruction: Use the Tyrian 2000 files included with the official package. Keep the Tyrian 2000 profile and game data together with the version you use.

steps.title: Use the upstream Android package
steps.instruction: On Android 11 or newer, unpack opentyrian2000-android.zip and install its signed APK with the included Tyrian 2000 data. Review and grant the app’s All files access permission to use its shared profile under Internal storage > Android > tyriandata. Back up that folder before replacing the app.

warnings: Apply upstream updates separately and keep your existing data, configuration and progress backed up. This downloaded copy remains upstream/player-owned.

references.title: Keep your current copy when updating
references.instruction: Apply upstream updates separately and keep your existing data, configuration and progress backed up. This downloaded copy remains upstream/player-owned.

references.title: Preserve the Tyrian 2000 profile
references.instruction: On Linux and Mac back up $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opentyrian2000 or ~/.config/opentyrian2000. Keep its saves and settings separate from the OpenTyrian 2.1 profile.
